headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 28, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a 6-4 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Luis García Jr. leading the charge at the plate. García Jr. went 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 9-4 defeat at the hands of the Pittsburgh Pirates, while the Texas Rangers edged out the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Roman Anthony has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list by the Boston Red Sox. Wyatt Langford has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Texas Rangers due to a left hamstring strain. Blake Dunn has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Cincinnati Reds retroactive to June 27, 2026, due to a right elbow sprain.

The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Hayden Juenger from the Toronto Blue Jays in a trade for catcher Owen Carapellotti. The Chicago Cubs acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for third baseman Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Orioles 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 6-4 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Luis García Jr. leading the charge at the plate. García Jr. went 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Pirates in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 9-4 defeat at the hands of the Pittsburgh Pirates. Ryan O'Hearn led the Reds' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Blue Jays in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers edged out the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2, with Nathan Lukes leading the charge at the plate. Lukes hit a crucial home run, his fourth of the season, to give the Rangers the win.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 7-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their recent matchup. Isaac Paredes led the Tigers' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Jack Flaherty pitched 5 strong innings for the Astros, striking out 9 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Roman Anthony Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Boston Red Sox left fielder Roman Anthony has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. This move indicates a longer-term recovery timeline for the player.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. Kennedy joins the Mariners in a move that aims to strengthen the team's lineup.
